offering_description.value: Provides consumer and commercial credit reporting, identity verification, fraud prevention and analytics data and software to businesses, governments and consumers. Sells mainly to lenders, employers and government agencies, delivering data through online platforms, data feeds and reports.

primary_products.value: credit reports and scores; identity verification software; fraud detection analytics; workforce verification data; commercial credit data

primary_services.value: credit information services; employment and income verification; identity theft protection; background screening; data and analytics consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: lenders, banks, card issuers, employers, insurers, retailers, telecom providers; B2C: individual consumers buying credit monitoring and identity protection; B2G: federal and state government agencies

end_markets.value: financial services; mortgage lending; employment and HR; insurance; government

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: fees per credit report, score or verification query; subscription: recurring fees for monitoring and data services; service fees: identity protection and analytics services; project or contract: government and enterprise data contracts
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; subscription; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: collects and sells consumer and business credit data to lenders and employers; software / platform: online verification and analytics platforms sold to enterprise customers; service provider: identity and background screening services sold to businesses and consumers
value_chain_position.category: financial intermediary; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, and Latin America countries with operations in dozens of markets worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: credit reporting, identity and fraud solutions, workforce and income verification, and commercial data lines sharing customers and data assets

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: enterprise sales teams selling to large lenders and employers; online: web portals and APIs for verification and reports; partners / resellers: integrations with software vendors and data partners

regulatory_exposure.value: high: consumer reporting under the Fair Credit Reporting Act, supervised by the CFPB and FTC, plus state data privacy and breach notification rules

notes: Business mix and geographic footprint are described from general knowledge and may have changed.
